knowledge_records.description: The user cannot access an account, log in, or use a password.
knowledge_records.recommended_action: Check account access and password recovery options.

knowledge_records.description: The user needs password recovery or help with a locked account.
knowledge_records.recommended_action: Guide the user through the account recovery process.

knowledge_records.description: The user reports a website or server error.
knowledge_records.recommended_action: Collect error details and route the request to technical support.

knowledge_records.description: The application crashes, has a bug, or fails to load.
knowledge_records.recommended_action: Ask for reproduction steps and relevant error details.

knowledge_records.description: The user asks about support availability or operating hours.
The user requests general information about the service.
knowledge_records.recommended_action: Provide relevant information or direct the user to the appropriate support channel.
